name: The Sunspire
dig_description: A sealed treasury beneath the Sunspire's foundation. Gilt fragments and shattered reliquaries litter the floor.
lore_blurb: The highest stratum — a soaring bastion of light and order, built atop the remains of an older covenant.
warden_intro: The air turns warm. Gold light spills across the marble.
A figure of blinding radiance blocks the sanctum gates.
"You have come far, dust-child. Farther than most. No farther."
The Light Warden draws a blade of pure dawn.
warden_outro: The light dims to ember-glow as the Warden kneels and dissolves.
The sanctum gates groan open before you.
boss_intro: Beyond the gates, an infinite white expanse.
At its centre: a shard of the First Dawn — the covenant's heart.
A voice without a speaker fills the space:
"THE FIRST LIGHT REMEMBERS EVERY PROMISE. AND EVERY BROKEN ONE."
boss_outro: The light falters, dims, and finally fades to dusk.
The First Dawn shatters into a million fading embers.
Silence. Then, far away, a single birdsong.
